description: This file defines functions to create various LINE messaging actions (message, URI, postback, datetime picker) using types from the '@line/bot-sdk'. It exports an Action type alias and several helper functions for constructing action objects.

methods.name: export function messageAction(label: string, text?: string): Action { messageAction
methods.description: Creates a message action object with a label and optional text, limited to 20 characters for label and optional 300 characters for text.

methods.name: export function uriAction(label: string, uri: string): Action { uriAction
methods.description: Creates a URI action object with a label and URL, with label limited to 20 characters.

methods.name: export function postbackAction(label: string, data: string, displayText?: string): Action { postbackAction
methods.description: Creates a postback action object with label, data, and optional displayText, with label limited to 20 characters and data to 300 characters.

methods.name: export function datetimePickerAction( datetimePickerAction
methods.description: Creates a datetime picker action with label, data, mode, and optional options for initial, max, and min date/time, with label limited to 20 characters and data to 300 characters.
